comparison_to_consumed_gate.note: Point estimate regressed 1.98 -> 1.20 pp as expected when an effect first observed at low power is re-measured, and stayed positive.

scope: This is a local current-field measurement of an already-live policy (Kaggle submission 55482233). It is not a ladder-strength claim and does not by itself authorize promotion, packaging, or upload.

slice_reproduction.finding: No slice-level story from the consumed gate reproduced. The Lucario mirror was reported as the only negative slice at -1.88 pp; at 4x power it is the BEST slice at +3.39 pp. Dragapult was reported +2.23 pp; here it is -0.22 pp. Both original readings were noise at n~300-700.
slice_reproduction.rule: Do not veto or promote on a slice measured at n < ~1000. Slice CIs here are +/-2 to +/-6 pp even at 8,192 games/arm.

verdict: PASSES positive and noninferiority; MISSES strict superiority by 0.045 pp. Same disposition as the original 2,048-game gate but with a 2x tighter interval, so the candidate is now a well-measured small positive rather than an inconclusive one.
